mappings.verbatim_snippet:
Conditions for transfer. An organisation may transfer personal data
overseas where the recipient is bound by legally enforceable obligations to provide a
standard of protection comparable to this Act, including binding corporate rules or
contractual clauses, or where the individual has given consent to the transfer of the
personal data to that country or territory.
Part IX — Enforcement

gives, or is deemed to have given, his or her consent under this Act to the collection,
use or disclosure of the personal data.

Correction of personal data. An individual may request an organisation to
correct an error or omission in the personal data about the individual that is in the
possession or under the control of the organisation, and the organisation shall correct
the personal data as soon as practicable.

mappings.verbatim_snippet:
Duty to notify. Where an organisation assesses that a data breach is a
notifiable data breach, the organisation must notify the Commission as soon as is
practicable, and in any case no later than 3 calendar days after making that
assessment, and must notify affected individuals where the breach is likely to result
in significant harm.
Part IX — Transfer of Personal Data Outside Singapore

mappings.verbatim_snippet:
Financial penalties. The Commission may, if it is satisfied that an
organisation has intentionally or negligently contravened a provision of this Act,
require the organisation to pay a financial penalty of an amount not exceeding 10% of
the organisation's annual turnover in Singapore or S$1 million, whichever is higher.

mappings.verbatim_snippet:
Transfer of personal data outside Singapore. An organisation shall not
transfer any personal data to a country or territory outside Singapore except in
accordance with requirements prescribed under this Act to ensure that the transferred
personal data will be accorded a standard of protection that is comparable to the
protection under this Act.

disposal or similar risks.
